text: Belavia (OAO "Aviakompaniya Belavia") is Belarus's state airline. When the airline was converted from a state enterprise into a joint-stock company, 100% of its shares were kept by the state, and in 2025 it was still described as Belarus's state airline.
short: Belavia is Belarus's state-owned airline; the state holds 100% of the shares.

source.name: The Insider: U.S. Treasury lifts sanctions on Belarusian state-owned airline Belavia and government jet used by Lukashenko's sons
source.quote: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has lifted sanctions on Belarus’s state airline Belavia

additionalSources.name: БДГ Деловая газета: Приказ об акционировании «Белавиа» подписан (order on Belavia's incorporation signed)
additionalSources.note: Russian. Belavia deputy marketing director Igor Cherginets: 'We are still counted as a RUP (state unitary enterprise), and in the OAO 100% of the airline's shares will belong to the state.'
additionalSources.quote: Мы пока еще считаемся РУП, но и в ОАО 100% акций авиакомпании будут принадлежать государству
